headline: Welcome to the HSN Literary Magazine
valueProp: We work with HSN students to refine creative techniques, and publish a magazine at the end of each year.

pillars.title: Creativity.
pillars.text: You don't need to be good at writing. If you have ideas and a soul, we'll help you put them onto the paper.

pillars.title: Visibility.
pillars.text: If you continue to attend meetings and improve your craft, your work will be featured in ours (and your) magazine.

pillars.title: Community.
pillars.text: Creating by yourself is never as fun as creating with others. Join us and find like-minded people!

vibe: We are ecstatic to have you!
